question: 单项选择：I have _____ finished my homework. A. yet  B. already  C. still  D. ever
answer: 答案：B. already。解析：already用于现在完成时肯定句，放在have和过去分词之间。

question: 单项选择：Have you finished your work _____? A. yet  B. already  C. just  D. still
answer: 答案：A. yet。解析：yet用于现在完成时一般疑问句，放在句末。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He hasn't arrived ______ (yet/already).
answer: 答案：yet。解析：yet用于现在完成时否定句句末。完整：He hasn't arrived yet.

question: 单项选择：She is _____ sleeping. A. already  B. yet  C. just  D. still
answer: 答案：D. still。解析：still"仍然"，表示动作持续进行，可以用于各种时态。

question: 翻译句子：你已经完成作业了吗？
answer: 答案：Have you finished your homework yet? 解析：yet用于现在完成时一般疑问句句末。

question: 单项选择：I have _____ finished my work. A. just  B. already  C. ever  D. A and B
answer: 答案：D. A and B。解析：just/already都可用于现在完成时肯定句。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：______ (Still) no one has answered my question.
answer: 答案：Still。解析：still"仍然"，可以用于现在完成时。完整：Still no one has answered my question.

question: 单项选择：He hasn't come back _____. A. already  B. yet  C. just  D. still
answer: 答案：B. yet。解析：yet用于现在完成时否定句句末。

question: 翻译句子：我刚刚看过这本书。
answer: 答案：I have just read this book. 解析：just"刚刚"用于现在完成时肯定句。read的过去分词是read。

question: 单项选择：She has _____ been to Paris. A. yet  B. already  C. still  D. ever
